mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-01.title: Weighted average
mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-01.body:
The final counts as two tests, so there are 6 "test slots": $\frac{76 + 88 + 96 + 98 + 2x}{6} = 94$, so $358 + 2x = 564$, $2x = 206$, $x = 103$.

**Answer: 103**

mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-01.title: Balance around 94
mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-01.body:
Differences from 94: $-18, -6, +2, +4$, total $-18$. The final, counting twice, must make up $+18$, i.e. $+9$ each time: $94 + 9 = 103$.

**Answer: 103**

mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-02.title: Deviations from 88.5
mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-02.body:
Subtract 88.5 from each score and add: the total is $1397 - 16(88.5) = 1397 - 1416 = -19$. So the mean is $88.5 - \frac{19}{16} = 88.5 - 1.1875$, and the difference is $1.1875 \approx 1.19$.

**Answer: 1.19**

mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-03.title: Weighted from 89
mathcounts-potw-2026-05-25-03.body:
The 8th graders are 5 points above 89, and they are $\frac{14}{26}$ of the class: $89 + 5 \cdot \frac{14}{26} = 89 + \frac{70}{26} \approx 89 + 2.692 = 91.69$.

**Answer: 91.69**
